Paper-proof coverage

The result catalogue includes 59 records: 56 accepted statements and three corrected statements. All named hypotheses are retained, including eight explicitly conditional records. Original drafts are replaced by the corrected English proofs. The two open targets and unresolved original victim-gate claim are excluded.

Reviewed proof edition · Audit scope and exclusions · Finite certificate data and checkers.

The renewed review treats public proof completeness as a separate requirement. The complete proof supplements define the token inventories, physical service times, abstract counterexample, finite-induction states and counting quantities used by the short result pages. Each result links its applicable supplement. The renewed paper review records the individual checks and corrected scope.

These are documented model-assisted reviews, not claims of human peer review. A finite replay proves its recorded finite obligations; universal conclusions also need the explicit induction or reduction argument supplied with the paper proof.
